title: CaffarelliKohnNirenberg
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg partial regularity theory for suitable weak solutions of the three-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with forcing in L^q, q > 5/2: the L^3 epsilon-regularity theorem (Theorem A), the gradient epsilon-regularity criterion (Theorem B) and the vanishing of the one-dimensional parabolic Hausdorff measure of the singular set (Theorem C). The three theorems are proved using only the standard axioms, restated together in a Mathlib-only comparator challenge and proved from the library theorems. The manuscript being formalized is in the repository and was corrected alongside the development.
